summary: Master tenant relations and lease negotiations with our expert-led training. Gain practical skills to navigate complex situations and improve your success rate.
lede: Tenant relations and lease negotiation training helps professionals working with leases, property operations, tenant accounts or commercial approvals manage lease decisions and tenant issues. Participants practise preparing lease abstracts and negotiation briefs, assessing rent, incentives and renewal options, and mapping repair responsibilities, service concerns and escalation plans. They also learn to document obligations and recommendations in a shared record for property and finance teams.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with leases, property operations, tenant accounts, or commercial approvals and need stronger negotiation and relationship-management discipline.
modules: Lease Data, Risk, and Financial Analysis
Executive Lease Strategy and Action Planning
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to lease administration, property operations, tenant communications, asset management, facilities coordination, property finance, or related real estate work. No coding or programming is required. Basic spreadsheet ability helps with rent schedules and NPV exercises. You should bring anonymized examples of lease clauses, tenant issues, or critical-date registers if organizational policy permits. Advanced legal interpretation, jurisdiction-specific drafting, and valuation certification are outside the implementation scope of this course.
